container.rtx-remix-renderer.copper_beac: Sets the color saturation of this beacon's lens and beam from grayscale to twice the dye's saturation.
Sets this placed beacon's beam and glowing lens brightness. Off disables both.
Sets the beam half-angle. 90 degrees illuminates a full forward hemisphere.
When enabled, the beam and head animation run only while the beacon receives redstone power.
Sets the axis's neutral angle. Animated bounds are offsets around this position.
Sets signed continuous rotation speed in degrees per second.
Sets the minimum animated offset from the neutral position.
Sets the maximum animated offset from the neutral position.
Sets the duration of one complete smooth oscillation.
Sets the time between deterministic smooth patrol targets.
rtxremix.settings.title: RTX Remix Settings (Community Edition)
rtxremix.settings.reset.tip: Restore the settings on this page to their default values.
rtxremix.settings.reset.confirm.title: Reset %s Settings?
rtxremix.settings.reset.confirm.message: This resets every setting in %s. Continue?
rtxremix.settings.resetAll.tip: Restore every RTX Remix setting to its default value. Restart afterward to return post-processing controls to gameplay profiles.
rtxremix.settings.resetAll.confirm.title: Reset All RTX Remix Settings?
rtxremix.settings.resetAll.confirm.messa: This resets every RTX Remix setting. Restart afterward to return post-processing controls to gameplay profiles. Continue?
rtxremix.settings.openRemixMenu.tip: Opens the RTX Remix Graphics Settings menu. Minecraft ignores input while it is open. Close it with its own close button or Alt+X.
rtxremix.settings.blockLights.title: Block Lights
rtxremix.setting.dist.autoFade.tip: Match the Remix terrain fade band to Minecraft's render distance without overriding stronger situational profiles.
rtxremix.setting.dist.light.tip: Chunks beyond which block lights are culled. Auto follows Minecraft's render distance.
rtxremix.setting.dist.entity.tip: Chunks beyond which entities are not submitted. Auto uses Minecraft's view distance.
rtxremix.setting.light.reach.tip: Blocks from the camera at which a torch stops casting light. Brighter lights reach further and dimmer ones less. Lower values shrink the light list the path tracer samples from.
rtxremix.setting.framerate.unfocused.tip: Framerate cap while the game window is not focused. Lower values leave the GPU to other applications. Unlimited leaves only Minecraft's Max Framerate in force.
rtxremix.setting.sky.ambient.tip: Toggle the ambient area light derived from the sky.
rtxremix.setting.sky.haloFocus.tip: Controls how tightly atmospheric haze gathers around the sun and moon. Higher values create smaller, brighter halos; lower values spread a softer glow across more of the sky.
rtxremix.setting.sky.minimumCelestialWea: Limits how much rain and thunder can hide the sun, moon, and stars. Time of day and horizon visibility are unchanged.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.volumetric.tip: Towering, physically lit cloudscapes: cumulus fields to the horizon, storm towers with anvils in thunder, overcast in rain. Near clouds cast shadows and light shafts; distant ones fade into the sky's own haze. Replaces the Cloud Style below while on. Community Edition feature.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.volumetricQualit: Sky resolution, ray-march steps and the reach of the shadow-casting near clouds. Low suits older cards; Ultra is sharpest and costs the most.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.coverage.tip: How much of a clear sky the volumetric clouds cover. Rain and thunder add to it.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.procedural.tip: Choose Procedural for soft, puffy clouds or Classic for Minecraft's blocky cloud style.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.vanillaEdgeSmoot: Softens the edges of Minecraft's classic blocky clouds. Set this to zero for sharp, square edges.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.size.tip: Makes clouds larger or smaller. For Minecraft's classic clouds, this changes how thick they are.
rtxremix.setting.clouds.height.tip: Moves clouds higher or lower in the sky.
rtxremix.setting.sky.sunIntensity.tip: Controls the brightness of direct sunlight. 1.00 uses the intended balance.
rtxremix.setting.sky.moonIntensity.tip: Controls the brightness of moonlight. 1.00 uses the intended balance.
rtxremix.setting.sky.dayAmbient.tip: Controls the strength of soft light from the daytime sky.
rtxremix.setting.sky.nightAmbient.tip: Adds extra soft light on top of the night sky's own lighting. Community Edition default 0 (upstream 2.50): the sky dome already lights the night in physical proportion, and extra fill flattens moonlit shadows and tints grass green.
Multiplies this block light's normal brightness. Off disables it; 1.00× keeps the intended brightness. Changes apply when you leave this screen and rebuild loaded terrain once.
rtxremix.setting.materials.terrainEmissi: Multiplies the light emitted by glowing block surfaces. Off disables their glow; 1.00× keeps the intended brightness. This does not change block lights such as torches.
rtxremix.setting.materials.smoothReliefM: Samples normal and height maps smoothly, which removes banding from surface bumps and depth, while block textures keep their pixelated look.
rtxremix.setting.materials.autoPbr.tip: Gives every block PBR without a resource pack: surface relief derived from its texture and a roughness that suits the material. Gold, iron, and copper blocks reflect as real metal; diamond blocks, ice, and polished stone are glossy. Textures from an installed PBR pack keep their own. Community Edition. Applies when you leave this screen and rebuilds loaded terrain once.
rtxremix.setting.materials.perceptualRou: Converts LabPBR smoothness to roughness as the LabPBR standard defines it, so grass, dirt, and stone stop looking oily. Turn it off for the original look. Community Edition. Applies when you leave this screen and rebuilds loaded terrain once.
rtxremix.setting.post.exposure.tip: Makes the whole scene brighter or darker. Changing it manually overrides gameplay profiles for this option.
rtxremix.setting.post.shadows.tip: Controls how bright shaded areas appear. Raise it to reveal more detail in shadows. Changing it manually overrides gameplay profiles for this option.
rtxremix.setting.post.highlights.tip: Controls sunlight, emissive blocks, and other very bright areas. Raise it to darken intense highlights and preserve more detail. Changing it manually overrides gameplay profiles for this option.
rtxremix.setting.post.lowLightAdaptation: Helps you see in dark places. Lower values reveal more detail, but can make illuminated areas look pale or washed out. Changing it manually overrides gameplay profiles for this option.
rtxremix.setting.post.highLightAdaptatio: Helps your view adjust to very bright scenes so sunlight and emissive blocks remain comfortable and readable. Higher values tame harsh brightness, but can make daylight look dimmer. Changing it manually overrides gameplay profiles for this option.
rtxremix.setting.post.motionBlur.tip: Blurs fast camera and object motion like a film camera. Standard is cheapest; High, Cinematic, and Ultra take more samples for smoother streaks and also blur glowing surfaces. Your hand and the block outline stay sharp. Community Edition.
rtxremix.setting.post.motionBlurShutterT: How long the virtual shutter stays open. Longer means longer streaks, and the same at any frame rate. 1/48 s is a film camera's 180-degree shutter; 1/24 s is the strongest.
The longest streak motion blur draws, as a share of the screen. Higher values let fast turns smear further; lower values keep them readable.
rtxremix.setting.community.overcastWeath: In rain and thunder the sky dims and a soft, even overcast light replaces the sunlit look, so the rain haze has light to glow in. Off restores the original weather lighting. Community Edition.
rtxremix.setting.community.wetGround.tip: Ground open to the sky darkens and gains a water sheen in rain, more on dense stone than on porous dirt, and dries slowly once the rain stops. Covered ground stays dry. Community Edition.
rtxremix.setting.community.rainRipples.t: While it rains, raindrops spread glossy ripple rings over open ground under a thin film of water. Vanilla rain splash particles are hidden while this is on. Community Edition.
rtxremix.setting.community.puddles.tip: Puddles gather on open hard ground such as paths, stone, and planks as the rain goes on, mirror the sky and everything around them, and shrink as the ground dries. Grass and sand never pool. Community Edition.
rtxremix.setting.community.cloudTint.tip: Clouds darken to storm grey in rain and to a dim blue at night instead of staying white, so they no longer glow at night or look brown in rain. Community Edition.
rtxremix.setting.community.realisticWate: Water lets light travel further, so shallows show their bed and depth turns blue-green, and each biome keeps its own water: clear turquoise warm oceans, murky swamps. Off restores the original dark water. Community Edition.
rtxremix.setting.community.animatedWater: Adds two slowly drifting wave layers to water surfaces, which hides the repeating wave pattern and roughens the surface while it rains. Community Edition.
rtxremix.setting.community.shoreFoam.tip: Draws drifting foam where water meets a solid shore. Community Edition. Applies when you leave this screen and rebuilds loaded terrain once.
rtxremix.setting.community.starryNight.t: Replaces Minecraft's stars with thousands of stars of varied brightness and colour, adds a faint Milky Way that a bright moon washes out, and gives moonlight a cool, stronger tint. Community Edition.
rtxremix.setting.community.volumetricQua: How finely fog and light shafts are resolved. Higher settings give crisper shaft edges and rain curtains at a frame-rate cost: High costs a few percent, Ultra noticeably more. Community Edition.
rtxremix.setting.community.goldenHourSha: At sunrise and sunset the low sun lights the morning mist and evening haze far more strongly, so trees and hills cast visible shafts of light. Community Edition.
rtxremix.setting.community.rainShafts.ti: In rain the ground stays overcast, but sunlight still lights the haze wherever it breaks through gaps in the clouds, as slanted shafts. Community Edition.
rtxremix.setting.community.lightningGlow: Lightning lights the storm: each flash lights up the rain haze around the bolt and throws brief, cold shadows, and distant strikes brighten the whole sky. Community Edition.
rtxremix.setting.community.naturalDaylig: A clear day lit by a warm sun and a blue sky in a believable ratio: sunlit ground brighter, shade blue rather than grey, distance fading to pale blue instead of a white veil, and a tighter glow around a smaller sun. Overall brightness stays about the same. Community Edition.
